snapshot.scope: Frozen full-cohort comparison and eight separately exposed development panels. No unified reasoning result is included.

model.training: No task-specific training in these comparisons
model.direct_parser_note: Full490, Bass and Stephan use saved Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct code, not code freshly parsed by the 27B reasoner. Older panels disclose their own saved-8B provenance. Gerstenberg2021 and Wu also include completed same-Qwen3.5-27B direct-parser controls.

metric_contract.r2_definition: Squared Pearson correlation, not accuracy, explained-variance regression R-squared, or the square of an average signed correlation.

numeric_units.nrmse: RMSE normalized by the native answer-domain width

metric_contract.null_policy: Undefined correlations, incomplete strict aggregates and unavailable clean controls remain null. Never replace them with zero or silently drop their cases.
metric_contract.full_cohort_aggregation: Average squared Pearson r equally over native response-type/scale groups within an experiment, then equally over experiments. Study rows summarize fixed study membership; studies are not the primary weighting unit.
metric_contract.signed_r_aggregation: Full-cohort and Bass signed_r is the same equal-type/equal-experiment mean, not a pooled correlation. Wu reports the experiment mean; its nrmse is explicitly pooled across eight scalar answers.

local_policy.constant_rule: Exact zero centered sum of squares

aggregation_caveats: Response type is defined by native schema regime and numeric bounds, not a study label or question tag.
Categorical outputs become option-level one-hot scalars; their R2 is not classification accuracy.
Squared correlation loses direction; always inspect signed r and normalized error.
The development panels use different interventions, scopes and controls. They must not be pooled or substituted into the frozen full490 table.
No held-out, statistical-significance, full physical-oracle, or robust whole-cohort success claim is supported.

diagnostic_membership.reason: Beller2025 exp1 has one scalar; Stephan2021 exp2 has two. They remain visible but are outside the fixed22 primary aggregate.

structural_undefined.explanation: Under the unchanged local min3 rule these groups are undefined even for perfect item predictions. This coverage check is not a human reliability ceiling or a physical oracle.

matched15.interpretation: Task evidence has higher squared correlation and lower normalized error on this shared subset, but lower mean signed r than direct/full code. This does not establish whole-cohort superiority.

full_cohort.coverage_caveat: The original catalog contained 280 quality-ranked sources, not an unselected representative corpus. The frozen490 are a narrower historical comparison, not all available visual questions.

method.name: Question-conditioned evidence from saved parsing
process: Bind the original question and sampled visual input to saved Parse Anything code.
Retrieve task-relevant objects, states, relations and supported measurements; use task computations only where defined.
Serialize the evidence with the unchanged native question, response domain and decoding contract.
Generate the final judgment with Qwen3.5-27B; freeze predictions before human-reference scoring.
method.reference_limit: Partial-reference inputs may omit temporal evidence, capabilities or task-critical fields. Their score is not a complete physical-oracle upper bound.

panels.title: Bass: explicit event semantics
panels.task: Physical probability, conjunction and intervention judgments; 40 slider questions and two categorical checks.

method.name: Explicit event-semantic handoff
method.summary: Disambiguate already computed model events without changing their physical facts. Separate event occurrence from a named collision relation, world, objects, time and ordering.
process: Reuse the frozen modeled factual/intervention episodes and their source bindings.
Represent positive sensor events separately from absence of a named collision within the horizon.
Preserve world identity, participants, intervals, order, finite-horizon limits and unresolved endpoints.
Render the same facts explicitly; retain the original video, question, header, schema and native decoder.
Use the unchanged 27B reasoner for the probability judgment; human targets enter scoring only.

panels.metric_context: All42 is the equal-weight mean of categorical and slider R2. The displayed nrmse is equal-type; nrmse_scalar is also retained.

gate.description: Each semantic arm exceeds its matched factual arm by at least 5 percentage points, with positive slider r and no nRMSE regression. This is not a whole-cohort or transfer gate.

diagnostics.title: All 40 slider questions
diagnostics.role: fixed diagnostic, not a replacement primary

diagnostics.title: Original 37 main-study slider questions
diagnostics.role: fixed diagnostic, not a replacement primary

diagnostics.title: Nine hit-conditioned questions
diagnostics.role: fixed diagnostic, not a replacement primary

limitations: Two categorical checks contribute four perfect one-hot items in every arm. All42 R2 = (1 + slider40 R2)/2, so 72.14% is neither accuracy nor slider-only performance.
Predicted slider40 R2 is 44.28%, signed r +0.6654, nRMSE 0.3391. Conditional9 R2 is 52.72%, below video 78.91%; conditional reasoning is not solved.
The explicit handoff changes interpretation, not parsing, simulation or physical facts in this contrast.

Reference positions, velocities, gravity and scene geometry are source-verified; five-second factual and object-removal events are model-derived. Differing source headers prevent an isolated parser-quality comparison; this is not a verified upper bound.
All 42 questions were exposed development data. No source-cluster uncertainty or held-out gain is established.

panels.title: Gerstenberg 2021: conditional trajectory
panels.task: Experiment 1 counterfactual subset: whether B would exit if A were removed.

method.name: Bounded static-arena numerical timeline
method.summary: Compute a conditional trajectory from unchanged observed boxes and source-supplied wall mechanics, then ask the VLM for the continuous judgment.
process: Select the first supported visible motion anchors for B, retaining times and provenance.
Remove A as the question stipulates; retain wall geometry and shared static elastic-wall assumptions.
Derive the gate corridor and execute supported contacts, velocity changes and whole-body exit checks.
Stop at the recorded horizon or unsupported geometry; do not invent completion.
Present the numerical timeline with the original visual input, question and common mechanisms to the reasoner.

panels.metric_context: Single slider response type on eight fixed questions; R2 is squared Pearson r.

gate.description: Both timelines have positive r, higher R2 and no worse nRMSE than video, full code, saved8B direct and the completed same27B direct control. Explanation faithfulness remains incomplete.

limitations: Only eight exposed counterfactual questions, not all 48 Gerstenberg2021 questions or an untouched holdout.
Adds physical computation and source-supplied mechanics; it is not a format-only ablation or unaided video baseline.
Box approximation differs from the source circular-body engine. Unsupported corner/contact states remain.
Some explanations turn unresolved stops into definite success or failure; high R2 does not establish faithful uncertainty handling.
Partial-reference geometry and historical source-identity caveats do not constitute a complete oracle.

panels.title: Gerstenberg 2022: common-schema timeline
panels.task: Experiment 2: conditional gate passage under the original intervention.

method.name: Conditional contact-by-contact numerical execution
method.summary: Instantiate the intervened scene from parsed geometry and motion, update velocity after supported contacts, and hand the bounded timeline to the VLM.
process: Retain source geometry, clocks, intervention and shared source-derived mechanism assumptions.
Search for supported contacts in the intervened scene and compute their velocity consequences.
Record the resulting event sequence, crossing predicates, stop reasons and unsupported dependencies.
Use one source-independent explanation-first answer schema for every arm.
Ask the reasoner for the original continuous rating, not a program-assigned probability.

panels.metric_context: Single slider response type; the common-schema comparison is distinct from earlier schema-dependent results.

gate.description: The direct-code answers are constant, so its correlation is undefined. Both timelines beat the defined controls and reduce error, but the strict all-control R2 gate does not pass.

limitations: Eight exposed cases, not held-out validation or the full study.
Direct parsing is saved8B, not the 27B reasoner. Video receives the shared mechanism rules.
The reference result is 61.15% in this matched schema; an older 95.27% result uses a different schema and cannot replace it.
A reference explanation correctly describes no crossing within the horizon but emits a high supporting rating; explanation/answer polarity and calibration remain unresolved.
Event-order agreement and good anchor geometry do not imply identical judgments or a complete oracle.

panels.title: Wu: executable action routes
panels.task: Five counterfactual questions in experiment 2 and three causal judgments in experiment 3.

method.name: Semantic action graph with conditional routes
method.summary: Combine frozen pixel-derived grid/actor/door observations with parsed identities, then compute legal transitions and route bounds under unknown future door states.
process: Bind source clocks, actors, grid geometry, OCR and door observations to the parsed scene.
Build an explicit action-state graph without filling unknown future states.
Compute legal transitions, feasible paths and bounds for the stated intervention.
Compare graph-only and graph-plus-calculation inputs with identical factual evidence.
Have the unchanged VLM supply the original human-judgment rating.

panels.metric_context: R2 and signed_r are equal-experiment means over the 5-question and 3-question experiments. nrmse is pooled across all eight scalars, not the mean of experiment RMSEs.

gate.description: The route candidate improves its matched graph by 18.12 percentage points and beats the completed own27B direct control. This is not an all-control strict pass: full-code correlation is undefined.

limitations: Full-code causal answers are constant; strict two-experiment R2 is null, not zero.
The gain comes primarily from three causal questions; counterfactual R2 slightly decreases.
Predicted graphs contain 79 observed action states versus 74 in older controls. Only the graph-versus-route contrast holds evidence fixed.
Same-method reference requests are native-input aliases of predicted requests, not independent oracle replications. The 93.89% reference row is an older, differently presented diagnostic.
No held-out cross-study transfer or whole-cohort claim follows from this panel.

panels.title: Sosa: complete-scene prospective evidence
panels.task: Experiment 2 binary judgments about future contact after disappearance.

method.name: Complete-scene graph with prospective clarification
method.summary: Preserve all scene objects and spatial relations, and clarify that the question concerns continuation rather than contact already seen.
process: Read the unchanged saved object graph, source timestamps and original image-plane coordinates.
Include context objects and complete scene relations rather than only target-pair measurements.
Render scene evidence with an explicit prospective task clarification.
Retain the original video, question and Yes/No answer domain.
Freeze model choices before comparing their one-hot scalars with human response proportions.

panels.metric_context: 22 binary choices yield 44 one-hot scalar items. Their R2 is not 86% classification accuracy.

gate.description: The candidate exactly matches the historical direct-code answers and attains the same 86.135706% hard-choice ceiling. It does not beat direct code; equally clarified direct/full controls are unmeasured.

diagnostics.description: Maximum positive correlation for deterministic Yes/No one-hot choices on this fixed panel. Not a human reliability ceiling, physical oracle or model input.

limitations: Clarification and complete-scene representation initially changed together. Clarified video and pair-graph controls help separate wording effects, but there is no complete-scene/no-clarification cell or matched clarified direct/full comparison.
Ten underlying sources support 22 question records; exact-input aliases are not independent scenes.
Partial-reference dynamic coverage is initial-only, not a temporal or physical upper bound.

The full490 task experiment later scores 30.41% on this same exp2, despite identical canonical graph, visual frames and question/schema. Delivery, ordering, added measurements and runtime source differ, so the regression has no isolated causal explanation.
No further improvement beyond this hard-choice ceiling can be claimed without changing the question/answer protocol; the current primary is not changed.

panels.title: Beller: event-local temporal paths
panels.task: Choose among four causal-language descriptions of interactions.

method.name: Chronological event paths with position anchors
method.summary: Augment parsed observations with source-pixel event measurements, then expose time-respecting paths and event-local positions without supplying a causal category.
process: Use parsed identities and coarse motion to select event windows in original video pixels.
Measure circles in those windows; retain missing/ambiguous observations rather than asserting absence.
Build near-contact events and before/after motion, with source time and measured geometry.
Connect only temporally supported paths and attach event-local position anchors; retain unknown counterfactual consequences.
Let the reasoner choose the original causal-language response. No removed-world outcome or human label is inserted.

panels.metric_context: 20 categorical responses yield 80 option-level scalars. These are not 80 independent videos.

gate.description: Anchored paths improve the three historical baselines but gain only 9.48 percentage points over dense notes, below the frozen 10pp threshold. Four of five gates pass; expansion is not supported.

limitations: The candidate extends perception with a study-specific circle observer; it is not unchanged Parse Anything or only a text reformat.
Near-contact windows and observed causal paths do not prove necessity or the removed-A outcome.
The 32.63% ball-only reference diagnostic changes only factual ball geometry, not all scene fields; it is not a complete physical oracle.
Later plots and tables regress to 16.04% and 19.79%, respectively; they are retained rather than selecting only the higher result.
Saved direct parsing is 8B, not same27B. Twenty exposed sources do not establish transfer.

panels.title: Smith: source-aligned visible evidence
panels.task: Physical-event expectation/surprise judgments on five exposed examples.

method.name: Image-coordinate observation graph
method.summary: Deliver complete source-aligned visible object states and relations under the frozen answer-only protocol, keeping predicted and recovered visible-reference inputs distinct.
process: Bind original sampled frames and timestamps to all saved object observations.
Use image-plane centers/boxes, visible identities and explicit unknowns; retain every source state and pair.
Render predicted observations and recovered visible-reference observations with the same graph method.
Keep the original video, task, answer-only schema and native decoding.
Score the frozen ratings without inventing explanations for answer-only outputs.

panels.metric_context: One scalar rating per question. A high squared correlation with negative signed r is not correct-direction success.

historical_only.label: Unblinded historical control; excluded from fair superiority claims
Unblinded historical control; excluded from fair superiority claims

gate.description: Predicted graph r is negative and R2 is below clean video. Clean code-control superiority is unavailable because cached direct/full prompts contain condition-bearing administrative names.

limitations: All ten cached code-control prompts are contaminated. Their historical metrics are preserved separately, not displayed as clean comparison scores.
Five questions are only a subset of the 20-question study; not held out.
Visible-reference evidence improves the local result but does not certify physical identity, hidden state or a complete oracle.
Answer-only outputs support no invented rationale. Improved geometry does not isolate the cause of remaining judgment errors.

panels.title: Stephan: goal-conditioned geometry
panels.task: Eight experiment-3 difficulty questions/order variants over two static diagrams; original slider [-50,50].

method.name: Straight-segment obstacle certificates
method.summary: Compute whether each actor-to-target center segment intersects a declared obstacle box. Independently source-correct the reference barrier through the geometry evaluator/exporter.
process: Keep the two original diagrams, source variants, questions, scale and original participant instructions.
Validate the reference barrier against source pixels and source rendering parameters; preserve historical reference results separately.
Compute center-segment/obstacle-box intersections from predicted or source-corrected geometry.
Append geometric predicates and unresolved finite-body/action qualifications to the matched base evidence.
Ask the unchanged reasoner for comparative difficulty; supply no simulated action, outcome or calibrated rating.

panels.metric_context: One slider type. Eight question variants are only two physical scene clusters. QA-ID nuisance differences remain in evidence prompts.

gate.description: Both certificate arms pass their own matched-base gates. Predicted 34.33% remains below direct 98.47%; corrected-reference certificates tie direct R2 with worse nRMSE.

limitations: Video/full answers are constant, so their correlation is undefined, not zero.
Only two diagrams underlie eight variants. Same-image video/direct/full inputs form two native classes, while evidence inputs retain administrative QA-ID differences.
Segment intersection is not finite-body clearance, a feasible physical action, success probability or subjective difficulty.
Two predicted certificate outputs contradict their own verbal direction when mapping to the signed response scale.
The original barrier-location instruction tension is preserved. Source-corrected reference geometry is not a complete physical oracle.
Identical reference-certificate and direct R2 follows from a positive affine relation between their two-group outputs, not identical calibration.

development_policy.selection: Eight named, historically exposed development panels, not an exhaustive trial inventory or untouched validation set.
development_policy.aggregate_reason: Heterogeneous methods, prompts, control provenance, scalarizations and dependent inputs prohibit a cherry-picked combined score.
shared_process: Task-valid measurement or physical operation where supported
Evidence delivered to the same reasoner
Native answer freeze, then human-reference scoring

unification.description: The shared representation was prepared and native-input checked. Inference was pending at this snapshot; preparation is not an improved reasoning result.
